rdfs:label: movedTo
rdfs:comment: On an ActivityStreams Actor, the new identity URI the Actor has migrated to — the forwarding address left behind on the old account.
notes: Forms the second half of the fediverse account-migration handshake. The *old* Actor sets `as:movedTo` pointing at the new identity; the *new* Actor lists the old in `as:alsoKnownAs`. Servers that see both sides confirmed automatically migrate followers; clients render the old account as redirected.

examples.title: An Actor that has migrated to a new server
